{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
The '''white bowl''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Apperance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is flattish and white, about a pace across.

==Use==
The bowl is said to be used for looking at things far away. It could have been meant as a communication device or an item for spying. Not much else is known about it.{{ref/book|11|15}}
